description_en: Queries the UUIDs of servers on which proactive defense of a specified type takes effect
description_zh: 按照防御类型查询主动防御生效的资产的UUID列表
name: DescribeSuspiciousUUIDConfig

parameters.help_en:
The type of proactive defense. Valid values:

auto_breaking: virus defense
ransomware_breaking: ransomware capture
webshell_cloud_breaking: webshell defense
alinet: malicious behavior defense
alisecguard: client protection
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的主动防御的防御类型。取值：

auto_breaking：防病毒
ransomware_breaking：防勒索（诱饵捕获）
webshell_cloud_breaking：网站后门连接防御
alinet：恶意网络行为防御
alisecguard：客户端自保护
parameters.name: type

Count.description_en: The total number of servers on which proactive defense of the specified type takes effect
Count.description_zh: 查询到该防御类型生效的服务器的总数量

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

UUIDList.description_en: The UUIDs of servers on which proactive defense of the specified type takes effect
UUIDList.description_zh: 查询到的该防御类型生效的服务器的UUID列表

items.description_en: The UUID of the server on which proactive defense of the specified type takes effect
items.description_zh: 查询到的该防御类型生效的服务器的UUID
